summary: The wrapper chart now deploys slice 015's relay into argocd-prd: chart/templates/webhook-relay.yaml carries the Deployment (image registry:5000/webhook-relay:2485, two replicas, maxUnavailable 0, the shared HMAC secret as a secretKeyRef at P2's argocd-webhook) and the Service fronted by deploy-hooks.webathome.org with is-public: yes, while argocd-server stays internal. tests/render-chart.py grows check_relay — the relay is the only internet-facing Service, both legs resolve to Services this render creates on ports they publish, and its secret is the one the receivers verify — negative-tested with 22 mutations plus an upstream port move. kc project test and kc project lint are green on 42b0860.
